title: Fix judge-debt door to key off route.lane, not lane.mode (fail-open P1)
action: P1 from the slice semantic judge: close.rs feature_route (~line 384-390) reads lane["mode"], but the live lane record carries mode:"feature" and the lane classification lives in route.lane — the judge-debt door is silently absent on real stores (fail-open), including workflow-lessons itself. Fix: read route.lane from the lane record (precedent: hooks/write_guard/hook_local.rs:524-530 and status_full/orient.rs:89-92), falling back to the default state route when the lane record lacks one; correct the provenance comment at close.rs:377-383 (the cited handlers_close.rs precedent keys off the CELL lane, not lane.mode). Update the wfl-3 tests: fixture lane records must carry the live shape ({mode:"feature", route:{lane:"standard"}}), plus one test proving mode:"feature"+route.lane:"standard" DOES grow the door and one that route.lane absent everywhere stays door-free. Also add the --report flag to the cells.finish registry entry in registry_payload.json (string surgery per wfl-2/wfl-4 precedent) so the wfl-1 flag is discoverable.

truths: mode:feature with route.lane:standard grows the door (the live workflow-lessons shape)
Comment cites a precedent that actually exists

trace.outcome: Fixed judge-debt door to key off route.lane instead of lane.mode, fixed wfl-3 fixtures to the live lane-record shape, and documented --report on the cells.finish registry entry
